patchBoard.ground: Safe pedestrian ground within the illustrated activity, never unsupported air or traffic
patchBoard.wardrobe: Warm ochre insulated jacket, muted teal snow trousers, dark snow boots and gloves; hood down behind neck so the face and curly hair remain clear.

hint.en: Replace only the yellow-jacket child holding a warm cup on the wooden boardwalk left of the ice-sample drill. Same stable boardwalk and smaller child scale; hat off and hood down so curls and full face stay readable. Preserve the cup and neighboring adult.
hint.he: חפשו ליד הילדים עם הספלים על מרפסת התחנה

placement.support: Replace only the yellow-jacket child holding a warm cup on the wooden boardwalk left of the ice-sample drill. Same stable boardwalk and smaller child scale; hat off and hood down so curls and full face stay readable. Preserve the cup and neighboring adult.
placement.lighting: Match the immediate neighboring painted faces, brown hand-drawn contours, matte color and shaped light/shadow planes. Adapt illumination, never replace the recognizable canonical Bar face or curls.
placement.occlusion: Keep all eyes, cheeks and characteristic curls readable. Natural object overlap only below the face. Remove the replaced bystander completely inside the edit window without orphan limbs. Preserve all neighbors.
placement.comparators: Age five, natural preschool proportions. Match the original child at this exact spot rather than an adult or tiny distant toddler. Equivalent standing height around 290 native pixels; visible head including curls approximately 60-85 native pixels, never a miniature, giant head or portrait cutout.
